1

The due-date calendar escaping the Edit box

not built yet

APPROVED — but NOT in this build, still to do

Where: the Edit window → Due Date.

"the due date section the the graph is not within the edit um, box and also it is um, smaller than what it should be."

what you said this time

You said "why can't you just fit to screen" — and that was the right instinct. I found the cause on the tenth attempt, and it was never the picker.

THREE pieces of code position this one picker: the function that builds it, a clamp that re-runs every 150ms, and a second placer that re-runs every 100ms. Both timers aimed at the modal shell (575px) while the dialog you actually see is 541px. That 34px difference, split either side, is the 17px I measured at every screen width — and a number that does not change with the window was the clue I missed nine times. Everything I did to the picker was overwritten within a frame.

Where it stands: both timers now share one rule, and the width is correct and steady at every size (498px inside a 541px dialog). I was part-way through confirming the position holds when the browser died competing with the test suites, so I have not yet proven it stays put. It stays amber until I have that reading — the earlier version of this fix flickered between right and wrong four times a second, and one lucky snapshot would have let me call it done.

how I would solve it

Size the picker to the Edit box instead of the whole window, so the two months sit side by side and nothing hangs outside.

Pressing space in a branch name deletes the space

APPROVED — goes live when you say so

Where: a branch name in the priority tree, e.g. Willingboro.

how I would solve it
